mage:A.name: Mage
mage:A.blurb: Casts the spells of your school. Joins an army to fight in it and power its battle spells.

market.name: Marketplace
market.blurb: A small, steady gold income; can be built in any province.

bank.name: Bank
bank.blurb: Raises the nation’s gold storage by 1000 (it starts at 2000).

magetower.name: Mage Tower
magetower.blurb: Unlocks Magic research and adds 2 Magic points every 10 s. Upgrades to a Mage Sanctum, then a Mage Arcanum.

temple.name: Temple
temple.blurb: A marble temple: adds 2 Government research points every payout. No research needed to build it; it never upgrades.

autoscout: Idle Wayfinders survey explored, unsurveyed provinces on their own. Toggle it on a Wayfinder’s command card.
bank: Unlocks the Bank: +1000 gold storage each (the nation starts able to hold 2000).
market: Unlocks the Marketplace: +3 gold every payout, buildable in any province.
stable: Unlocks the Stable, which lets a Barracks in the same province train Cavalry.
magetower: Unlocks the Mage Tower, which trains Mages and opens Magic research. Your first tower lets you choose a school of magic.
walls2: Walls are built of stone, and existing palisades are rebuilt in stone: three times as strong.
traderoutes: Your capital makes +1 gold for every Marketplace it can reach by road, through any number of your provinces.
stealth: Wayfinders can sneak: three times slower, but enemy armies can’t see them. Without it, an enemy army that finds a Wayfinder kills him.
farsight: Wayfinders see into every province next to the one they stand in, and every unexplored province they look into is explored for good.
horde: An army of 10 or more cavalry and no other units has 1.3 times the health. A horseshoe over the army shows when it is active.
horse-breeding: Needs Building: Stable (Government). Cavalry can ride Arabians (fastest, fragile) or Mongolian horses (cheap to feed, at home in forest and swamp, weak charge).
horse-training: Unlocks Friesians (the hardest charge) and armored Percherons (toughest, but slow and hungry).
sanctum: Lets a Mage Tower be upgraded to a Mage Sanctum (Magic Tier II).
arcanum: Lets a Mage Sanctum be upgraded to a Mage Arcanum (Magic Tier III).
apprentice: Your Mage limit rises by 1: you can train a second Mage.
forge: Unlocks the Forge, which opens Military research. Owning a Barracks makes this technology 50% more likely to be offered.
earthquake: A Mage standing in an enemy province your army occupies can cast an Earthquake (200 mana: it needs Magic Abundance): after 30 seconds every building in that province is destroyed, and every wall on its borders takes 120 wall damage (enough to bring down any wall).
mushroom: Farms can be built in swamps too: damp, dark beds of mushrooms.

mag.name: Magic
mag.locked: Research the Mage Tower (Government Tier II), then build one to unlock Magic.
mag.rate: Mage Tower +2, Sanctum +4, Arcanum +6 per payout

gov.name: Government
gov.rate: Forts +2, Capital +3, Temples +2 per payout (outposts give none)

pioneer:B: Scurries through fog on all fours and surveys land.
mage:A: Casts the spells of your school. Joins an army to fight in it and power its battle spells.

stable.name: Ogre Cave
stable.note: trains Ogres · needs a mountain border
stable.blurb: A cave in the mountainside where Ogres lair: trains Ogres (no Barracks needed). Needs a mountain border.

market.name: Thug Den
market.blurb: Trains Thugs and houses them (2, more with research). Each Thug inside makes 1 gold every 10 s; twice that with Highwaymen if the den borders another nation.

bank.name: Supply Cache
bank.blurb: Raises the nation’s gold, wood and food storage by 500 each.

magetower.name: Warlock Tower
magetower.blurb: Trains Warlocks, unlocks Magic research and adds 2 Magic points every 10 s. Upgrades to a Warlock Spire, then a Warlock Grand Spire.

temple.name: Hot Springs
temple.blurb: A steaming pool in the bog: adds 2 Government research points every payout. Only in a swamp.

farm.blurb: Beds of wild mushrooms. Swamplings farm swamps from the start.

autoscout: Idle Swampstriders survey explored, unsurveyed provinces on their own. Toggle it on a Swampstrider’s command card.
bank: Unlocks the Supply Cache: +500 gold, wood and food storage each.
market: Unlocks the Thug Den: trains Thugs and houses 2 of them. Each Thug inside makes 1 gold every 10 s.
stable: Unlocks the Ogre Cave (needs a mountain border), which trains Ogres.
magetower: Unlocks the Warlock Tower, which trains Warlocks and opens Magic research. Your first tower lets you choose a school of magic.
walls2: Walls are bristling with spikes, and existing palisades are rebuilt: three times as strong.
traderoutes: Thugs make twice as much gold when their Thug Den borders another nation.
stealth: Swampstriders can sneak: three times slower (but no slower at all in a swamp), and enemy armies can’t see them. Without it, an enemy army that finds a Swampstrider kills him.
farsight: Swampstriders see into every province next to the one they stand in, and every unexplored province they look into is explored for good.
horde: An army of 10 or more Ogres and no other units has 1.3 times the health. A horseshoe over the army shows when it is active.
horse-breeding: Needs Building: Ogre Cave (Government). Ogres can be Swampfeet (fastest, frail) or Mossback (cheap to feed, at home in forest and swamp, weak blow).
horse-training: Unlocks Bloodknuckle Ogres (the hardest blows) and Leviathan Ogres (toughest, but slow and hungry).
sanctum: Lets a Warlock Tower be upgraded to a Warlock Spire (Magic Tier II).
arcanum: Lets a Warlock Spire be upgraded to a Warlock Grand Spire (Magic Tier III).
apprentice: Your Warlock limit rises by 1: you can train a second Warlock.
forge: Unlocks the Forge, which opens Military research. Owning a Barracks makes this technology 50% more likely to be offered.
earthquake: A Warlock standing in an enemy province your army occupies can cast an Earthquake (200 mana: it needs Magic Abundance): after 30 seconds every building in that province is destroyed, and every wall on its borders takes 120 wall damage (enough to bring down any wall).
mushroom: Swamplings know this from the start: mushroom beds in swamps.

rep-shockcast: Fireball takes 5% less time to cast.

mag.locked: Research the Warlock Tower (Government Tier II), then build one to unlock Magic.
mag.rate: Warlock Tower +2, Spire +4, Grand Spire +6 per payout

gov.rate: Forts +2, Capital +3, Hot Springs +2 per payout (outposts give none)
